Enable Hiring Workflow
fields.description: Master switch for the stage-based Hiring Workflow. When ON, Job Openings auto-fill hiring stages and Job Applicants gain the Hiring Workflow tab, stage buttons, and auto-advance. When OFF, recruitment works exactly as before.

fields.label: Enable Initiate Onboarding Button
fields.description: Shows an 'Initiate Onboarding' button on accepted Job Applicants that auto-creates the Employee Onboarding with the default Onboarding Portal Form, resolved Buddies/Manager, Recruiter and Onboarding SPOC pre-filled into the Onboarding Automation tab. When OFF, onboarding still auto-creates on Job Offer acceptance exactly as before.
Show the "Send Pre Offer Form" button on the Job Applicant form and the bulk action in the Job Applicant list. When unticked, the button/action is hidden for everyone.

fields.description: Show the "Send Pre Onboarding Form" button on the Job Applicant form and the Job Offer form. When unticked, the button is hidden for everyone.

fields.description: Master switch for TA SLA Settings. When ON, the system measures Turn Around Times (Time to Fill/Hire/First Action) against configured points & targets, and flags stage SLA breaches for recruiters. When OFF (or when TA SLA Settings is left unconfigured), recruitment works exactly as before — no computation, notifications, or archival run.
